parameters.prompt: The exact snake-tailed demon lady in the reference performs ONE ordinary spitting attack in place. From the resting pose she draws the head and upper body back and slightly up, then snaps the head forward toward screen left with the mouth open as if spitting, both hands staying near the body, holds for a brief moment, then closes the mouth and calmly returns to the exact original pose and holds it. The tail stays coiled and does not slither or move across the ground. Exactly two arms and one snake tail. Keep the same three-quarter left view, face, hair, headdress, clothing and scaled tail. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No slithering, turning around, jumping, second attack, extra limbs, weapon, projectile, liquid, venom, glow, energy, smoke, dust, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: draw back over the first second, the spit snaps forward around one and a half seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
